title: Short literature check: PPS life cycle is known (Schmickl 2016, which also fixes the clockwise turning sign and gives a replication density threshold ~0.054); swimming condensates in experiment swim toward dissolution, the opposite of our resource-seeking ringed cells
summary: Two primary sources opened. Schmickl et al. 2016 report the same PPS life cycle as our claim (spores 14-22 particles, cells 23-60, division at ~61, logistic growth), state that a positive turn is clockwise (explaining our handedness note), and give density thresholds for replication (~0.054 p/su) that the ledger has not tested. Jambon-Puillet et al. 2024 show droplets swimming toward their own dissolution; our kernel-drive ringed cells swim toward the substrate that maintains them, and Demarchi 2023 stays the nearest model (variant). One question raised: a PPS density sweep.
